meta.description: Extend and retract Somfy RTS awnings from Home Assistant. A small radio node acts as one more remote, so the handset keeps working and Home Assistant follows it. The awnings' own wind sensor is read too, and shows when the awnings have rolled themselves in. The awnings retract at sunset, and a notification comes when the wind sensor has not been heard for days.

cc1101.description: A radio transceiver module for the sub-gigahertz bands, wired to the ESP32 board over SPI.
cc1101.does: Sends and receives the 433 MHz frames of Somfy RTS, so the node can drive the awnings, hear the handset and hear the wind sensor.

status.title: Awning status
status.description: Read configured cover state and its estimated position.

wind.title: Wind report
wind.description: Report the wind alarm and when the sensor was last heard.
examples: What does the wind sensor report?

explain.title: About awnings
explain.description: Awnings report estimated positions and wind alarms; a cleared alarm does not prove calm.

extend.title: Extend the awning
extend.description: Request extension only with explicit access and fresh, safe wind evidence; existing protection still applies.

retract.title: Retract the awning
retract.description: Request retraction with explicit access, without a safe-wind assertion.

stop.title: Stop the awning
stop.description: Request STOP with explicit access when the integration supports it; position may be estimated.
